kind: native persistent Rust agent with control plane

runtime.execution: Current split crates runtime: Tokio turn engine with mutable request hooks, concurrent tools, named agent/delegate tasks, WASM tool plugins and configurable memory.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns task control plane, sessions/processes and runtime workspace; consumes providers/MCP/plugins/remote channels. This fabric ownership exceeds Arconaut role.

summary: Real model pipeline tool and peer-directed recipient turns; config-generation boundaries and live plugin config are useful, while terminal cancellation can precede worker shutdown.

inspection.scope: Traced current crate paths (src reexports): shell/drains/kill guard, turn hooks/steering, pipelines, peer admission/delivery, delegate cancellation, live config and persistence/overflow.
inspection.limits: Source only; no acquired code executed. SOP full lifecycle, all memory/provider/plugin backends, every RPC refresh and archive retention not exhaustively traced.

evidence.claim: Drop sends process group KILL best-effort; disarmed after root wait.
Concurrent capped stdout/stderr drains; timeout start_kill then drains abort, no awaited root death in timeout branch.
Actual model spawn/peer/model routing/switch tool registration.
Validates every step allowlist/registry before effects; sequential outputs interpolate into later arguments.
Parallel JoinSet tools sorted by input index; early failure drops pending tasks, not foreign effects rollback.
Model pipeline requires unrestricted principal; all/last output modes.
Durable inbox task registration required before success/admitted recipient execution.
Spawn separate recipient turn with sender principal, capture cost context, settle task; success reports acceptance.
Recipient process_message builds one-shot system+user history, not shared resident IRC context.
Steering drained between iterations and appended; cancellation boundary check. Gate/Annotate policy branches still TODO.
Actual pre-LLM hook mutates complete request messages/model; suffix cannot be assumed for arbitrary transforms.
Model/profile/prompt hooks return replacement or cancel; panic retains prior values.
Token select drops active tool future; no universal external-effect settlement contract.
Named non-agentic provider/model call bounded by await timeout, not provider-side termination.
Durable terminal transition wins BEFORE cancellation token signalled; returned aborted means token existed, not completed worker.
Delegate task visibility bound to originator chain; legacy terminal artifacts readable but not mutable.
Legacy token.cancel then file status Cancelled and claims aborted, without task join.
Exact token remains active on store failure and cancelled only after terminal write; does not prove worker termination.
Turn boundary config generation stable for route/limits; direct ACP/WS construction stays pinned until reconnect.
Actual feature-gated WASM plugin host receives live config handle.
Real Agent construction and plugin execution observe changed config via same tool instance, literal before/after oracle.
Context overflow drops oldest whole turns, token count excludes schemas/images in reactive path; inserts breadcrumb.
Provider failure events sanitize error, explicitly capture no prompt/completion content.
Interactive JSON writes current projection directly, not append-only original archive.
Truncation reports loss without retaining second original copy.
Model knowledge capture/search/relate/lessons/graph/interaction actions dispatcher; storage backend not traced.

tests.oracle: Actual Agent constructor/component execution exact before/after values without registry rebuild; not run.
Token remains uncancelled if store fails, changes only after terminal write; no actual worker liveness oracle; not run.

strengths: Coupled route/limits config generations adopted at supported turn boundary.
Actual model pipeline interpreter with complete step preflight.
Peer acceptance and task registration accurately distinguished from delivered final output.
limits: Durable Cancelled transition can precede cancellation signal and confirmed worker settlement.
Peer tool recipient path is a fresh one-shot turn, not live resident room context.
Trimming/current-history overwrites and bounded failure events cannot supply original audit.
arconaut_questions: Retain config-generation coherence while applying changes after affected workflows conclude.
Keep cancellation requested/draining/settled state separate from terminal result visibility.
Let workflows hide intermediate blobs from active context while retaining originals for audit.
